description: [Ncloud Storage] Get the lifecycle configuration of a Ncloud Storage bucket (GET /?lifecycle): transitions to ONEZONE_IA / DEEP_ARCHIVE, expiration, and noncurrent-version rules. Returns configured=false with an empty rule list when no configuration exists (instead of a NoSuchLifecycleConfiguration error).

bucketName.description: Name of the bucket to retrieve lifecycle configuration for

expectedBucketOwner.description: x-amz-expected-bucket-owner — expected owner account number of the bucket: the account number inside any resource NRN (nrn:PUB:<service>:<region>:<accountNo>:…, e.g. from ncloud_resource_list_resources). The 36-char owner ID from ncloud_ncs_list_buckets is rejected as InvalidBucketOwnerAWSAccountID. A different owner is rejected with AccessDenied (403)

name: ncloud_ncs_get_bucket_lifecycle
